description: Check a federal construction week's payroll end to end in two recompute stages: first recompute whether each worker on a caller-declared certified payroll was paid at or above the wage-determination rate for their classification, with Contract Work Hours and Safety Standards Act overtime at time-and-a-half on the basic hourly rate (ART-574), then attest that the week's bulk disbursement run is internally consistent and matches its authorized control total in count and value, with duplicate candidates, roster movement, and limit breaches surfaced (ART-518), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). Payroll rows, wage determinations, payee records, and control totals are caller-supplied inputs; a deficiency or a reconciliation break is an arithmetic finding, never a legal determination. Not legal advice.
name: certified-payroll-compliance-pack

steps.handoff: Recomputes, for one stated certified-payroll week, whether each worker on a caller-declared payroll was paid at or above the wage-determination rate for their classification, with Contract Work Hours and Safety Standards Act overtime at time-and-a-half on the basic hourly rate and fringe due straight-time for every hour

Attests that a bulk payment run is internally consistent and matches its authorization: reconciles per-payee records against the authorized control total in count and value, surfaces duplicate-candidate clusters, reports payee roster movement against the prior run, and flags limit breaches
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Certified Payroll Compliance Pack
